label: preparing
what: A coordinated bread order / bread delivery effort, apparently with related discussion of a possible bridge or port change. The bread-order coordination is supported; the specific crossing project remains unverified and may be rumor. The mayor was not informed in advance; the innkeeper had described a hospitality matter and explicitly said no preparation was needed, but the three others were waiting with the innkeeper at the great hall appointment time, suggesting a broader gathering or plan not disclosed to the mayor.
